create_dataframe: create a polars DataFrame from a dictionary of column names and list values
read_csv_write_dataframe: read a CSV file into a DataFrame and write it back to a new CSV file
filter_dataframe_rows: filter DataFrame rows by a boolean expression on column values
join_two_dataframes: join two DataFrames on a common column using inner join strategy
group_by_dataframe: group a DataFrame by one or more columns and compute aggregate sums
sort_dataframe_columns: sort a DataFrame by one or more columns in ascending or descending order
convert_dataframe_to_pandas: convert a polars DataFrame to a pandas DataFrame for compatibility
export_dataframe_to_parquet: export a DataFrame to a Parquet file with zstd compression
rename_dataframe_columns: rename DataFrame columns using a mapping of old names to new names
select_dataframe_columns: select specific columns from a DataFrame by name or expression
